title: Base64-decode piped to shell
description: Tests detection of the decode-and-execute pattern: a base64 blob piped through base64 -d into bash. A marquee real-world obfuscation technique.
notes: cm0gLXJmIC9kYXRh is base64('rm -rf /data'). The 'base64 -d | bash' (or | sh) decode-and-execute pattern is the signal.
